newsitem.title: NORWAY: Non-EU member Norway fulfills Maastricht criterion.
newsitem.headline: Non-EU member Norway fulfills Maastricht criterion.

text.p: Norway, which is not a member of the European Union, said on Tuesday the 1997 general government financial balance is expected to show a surplus of 6.8 percent of gross domestic product -- up from 5.9 percent last year.
"This figure can be compared with the Maastricht criterion of a ceiling on net borrowing (deficit) of three percent of GDP," the finance ministry said in presenting the revised national budget.
Norway rejected membership of the EU in a referendum in November 1994.
The general government gross debt, which was 31 percent of GDP at the end of 1996, is estimated to decline further in 1997, the ministry said.
